# Craton Technologies

Craton Technologies is a product and IP company in Frisco, Texas, founded by Sheik Ahamed Ali. It invents and ships AI-enabled products for regulated work. RAccelerator is in development for EU MDR and IVDR technical documentation and GSPR gap assessment. ReviewsIntel is evidence tooling for agentic commerce. The site states 3 US patents granted and 9 pending as of August 2026, and a first RAccelerator enterprise evaluation in September 2026. Illustrative quotes on the site are not customer endorsements.
